units.title: Present simple: negatives
units.theory:
## Negatives

Use **do not** (*don't*) or **does not** (*doesn't*) before the verb.

| Subject | Negative |
| --- | --- |
| I, you, we, they | do not work |
| he, she, it | does not work |

accept: Our printer [does not|doesn't] work on Mondays

items.prompt: The two cats share a bowl.
accept: The (two) cats do not share a bowl
It does not rain much here
It does not rain a lot here

exercises.task: Rewrite the note so that every sentence is negative.
exercises.prompt: The lift works. We use the stairs.
exercises.model: The lift does not work. We do not use the stairs.

exercises.task: Write three things you do not do at weekends.
exercises.sample: I do not set an alarm. I do not check my work mail. I do not cook.
